messages:
Lina: quick heads-up  bringing rank-lite v1.2 (dynamic-int8 build) to canary for a short quality pass. initial offline looks odd: small NDCG change but MRR shows a hit concentrated on queries with punctuation/emojis. posting numbers.

EvalBot: offline compare rank-lite-v1.2-int8 -> baseline float32
EvalBot: NDCG@5: 0.791 -> 0.788 (-0.003)
EvalBot: MRR@10: 0.642 -> 0.603 (-0.039)  <-- >70% of MRR loss from queries with trailing punctuation or emoji tokens

Jordan: that magnitude on MRR from a narrow slice is suspicious. might be a tokenization/normalization mismatch + quant tail effects. do we have examples?

Lina: pulled some failed samples:
Lina: "best sushi near me..." -> ranking drops (ellipses counted as tokens)
Lina: "how to fix a flat tire 🚲" -> different tokenization around emoji vs word boundary
Lina: "docs: API keys?" -> punctuation adjacent to tokens gets split weirdly

Mei: emoji and punctuation often create extra tokens with our vocab which short queries are very sensitive to. two quick triage steps:
Mei: 1) run tokenizer diff raw vs unicode-normalized (NFKC) + strip control chars
Mei: 2) run quant-kernel ablation: dynamic-int8 per-channel vs per-tensor, and static 4-bit benchmark if available

Carlos: i can run kernel ablation on the canary cluster. command i'll use for the eval harness:
Carlos: ```bash
Carlos: python infra/eval_harness.py \
Carlos:   --model rank-lite-v1.2-int8 \
Carlos:   --dataset holdout \
Carlos:   --limit 20000 \
Carlos:   --slice "punctuation_or_emoji" \
Carlos:   --output /tmp/ranklite_int8_ablation.csv
Carlos: ```

Mei: also add raw_hex and unicode_normalized fields in the eval CSV. quick Python helper i use to inspect problematic bytes:
Mei: ```python
Mei: def hex_bytes(s):
Mei:     return s.encode('utf-8').hex()
Mei:
Mei: examples = ["best sushi near me...","how to fix a flat tire 🚲"]
Mei: for e in examples:
Mei:     print(e, hex_bytes(e))
Mei: ```

Jordan: good call. our dashboard masks nonprintables and truncates at 80 chars which hid the trailing U+2026 in some samples. adding the hex field will help.

EvalBot: quick re-eval with NFKC + remove-control-chars normalization on queries:
EvalBot: NDCG@5: 0.791 -> 0.790
EvalBot: MRR@10: 0.642 -> 0.629
EvalBot: (MRR gap reduced to -0.013)

Lina: normalization explains a chunk. remaining delta may be quant-kernel sensitivity for short sequences with weird token splits.

Carlos: starting per-channel int8 run now. will compare outputs and attach diffs. estimate ~2 hours.

Mei: small infra note: when you push eval CSVs to s3 please gzip and include a small sidecar .meta with normalization flags used so future replays are reproducible.

CI-Bot: canary deployment completed: rank-lite v1.2-int8 -> canary (tag: 2026-03-18-ranklite-v1.2)

Jordan: if per-channel int8 closes the residual gap, we can adopt that kernel for serving for this model. if not, we may need to force a preprocessing normalization in the serving stack for a short-term roll.

Lina: plan of record:
Lina: - PR to add raw_hex + unicode_normalized + normalize_flag to eval harness (today)
Lina: - Carlos runs per-channel vs per-tensor int8 ablation (in progress)
Lina: - 50k re-eval cleaned vs raw to estimate population impact (Fri)
Lina: - decision: if residual MRR delta <= 0.01 roll forward; else hold until kernel change or serve-side normalization (rollback criteria documented)

Carlos: uploaded preliminary per-channel run files: s3://redwood-evals/rank-lite/v1.2/int8-per-channel-diff.csv.gz  (I'll drop pointer in #eng-ml when the full run finishes)

Mei: tagging @Lina @Jordan on PR once ready. also logging the anchor pairs for manual inspection.

Lina: thanks all. extra ask: can someone add a quick unit test to the tokenizer repo that asserts NFKC(normalize) + remove_ctrl is identity for our train/dev ingest pipeline so this doesn't recur silently? small patch could live in infra/tests/tokenizer_normalize_test.py

Jordan: will take the test. follow-ups in thread. :rocket:
